item.title: CEO Fundraising Sr. Specialist
item.description: Position Overview Title: CEO Fundraising Sr. Specialist Classification: Full-time Salary range is for candidates based in the New York City Metropolitan area. Outside of the NYC metro, we differentiate salaries based on location. It is customary for entry-level candidates to join Women’s World Banking at the lower half of the range to leave room for candidates to grow, expand, and develop in the role. It is common for starting salaries to fall in the mid-point of the range for more experienced candidates. We negotiate actual salaries with final candidates based on their exact location, experience in similar roles, and expertise related to the qualifications. The CEO Fundraising Sr. Specialist will play a pivotal role in advancing fundraising efforts led by the President and CEO, recognized as Women's World Banking's most effective fundraising asset. In this role, you will work in direct partnership with the CEO to identify, develop, and advance a strong pipeline and portfolio of prospective supporters, helping create opportunities that contribute to the organization's long-term fundraising goals. A significant element of this work involves supporting the implementation of the CEO’s fundraising strategy and the development of a principal gifts pipeline under her leadership. You will be responsible for building and advancing a robust pipeline of prospective supporters, creating a disciplined cultivation process that generates a steady flow of new and engaged donors. This work supports the CEO's fundraising objectives, which include securing $10 million annually, representing approximately half of the organization's overall fundraising target, with at least half of that funding being unrestricted. While the organization's broader fundraising strategy is developed by senior leadership, the CEO defines the fundraising strategy and priorities needed to achieve her fundraising goals within that framework. This role is responsible for helping to bring that strategy to life through generating opportunities, advancing prospects, and contributing to fundraising objectives. Success in this role requires a combination of strong research and analytical skills, sound judgment, persistence, and a sales-minded approach to relationship development. The ideal candidate is energized by opening doors, connecting the dots across networks, creating momentum, and helping move relationships from prospect to partner. While not a front-line fundraising role, this position requires the same discipline, urgency, organization, and initiative to build the systems and partnerships that drive fundraising success. Collaboration with Board members, senior leadership, Development colleagues, and other members of the CEO's front office team will be essential to identifying, cultivating, and advancing opportunities. The successful candidate will be comfortable engaging with high-level stakeholders, exercising discretion and sound judgment, and representing Women's World Banking with professionalism and credibility in a variety of external settings.
item.dc:creator: Women's World Banking

item.title: Development Officer
item.description: Title: Development Officer Location: All Stars Project of New Jersey Job Status: Full-Time, Non-Exempt, Hybrid Reports to: Director of Development, All Stars Project (ASP) of New Jersey Salary range: $56,000–$65,000/annualized ($26.93–$31.25/hour) Job Summary The Development Officer is a key member of the All Stars Project (ASP) of New Jersey (NJ) development team, which raises $1.75 million annually to support our NJ operations. This position combines frontline fundraising, donor engagement, grant writing, event management and development operations to strengthen and grow the organization’s philanthropic partnerships while developing as a fundraiser and leader. Working closely with the Director of Development, the Development Officer will help cultivate and steward individual, corporate and foundation relationships through strategic communications, donor meetings, fundraising campaigns, grant proposals and reports, and special events. The role manages a portfolio to develop meaningful relationships that inspire increased engagement and charitable investment. It also requires active collaboration across ASP’s national Development team and broader organization, contributing to shared fundraising goals, continuous learning, and a culture of growth, feedback, and partnership. The position is a hybrid role and typically requires three days of in-person attendance in the ASP New Jersey regional office. Responsibilities Donor Relationship Management Manage and grow a portfolio of approximately 80–100 individual donors and prospects, primarily giving between $50 and $2,500, through personalized cultivation, frontline solicitation, stewardship, and ongoing engagement. Develop and implement individualized engagement strategies to increase donor retention, giving levels, and long-term philanthropic partnership that reflect ASP's relationship-centered approach to fundraising. Conduct donor outreach through phone calls, email, virtual meetings, and in-person visits, documenting all interactions in Raiser's Edge NXT. Fundraising & Annual Giving Support the implementation of ASP New Jersey's annual strategy in partnership with the Director of Development and National Annual Campaign team to achieve $1.75 million in fundraising. Coordinate donor, foundation, corporate partner, trustee, and prospect meetings, including briefing materials, scheduling, follow-up, and next-step strategies. Produce donor-centered communications, including email newsletters, stewardship messages, fundraising appeals, impact stories, campaign materials, and special announcements. Research prospective corporate and foundation supporters to identify new funding opportunities. Foundation & Corporate Giving Research, write, and coordinate Letters of Inquiry (LOIs), grant proposals, reports, and supporting materials to submit, secure, and steward foundation and corporate funding. Maintain grant calendars, reporting deadlines, and proposal tracking to ensure timely submissions and compliance with funder requirements. Partner with program and finance staff to gather data, outcomes, and financial information for grant applications and reports. Events & Donor Engagement Support the planning and execution of the annual New Jersey Fall Benefit by managing donor outreach, invitation tracking, sponsorship fulfillment, registration, reporting, acknowledgments, and post-event follow-up. Coordinate and produce donor cultivation and stewardship events, including Board and Trustee meetings, receptions, volunteer experiences, and other fundraising activities. Assist with logistics and fundraising activities that maximize donor engagement before, during, and after events. Development Operations Maintain accurate donor records and gift data in Raiser's Edge NXT and other development systems. Coordinate acknowledgment letters, donor recognition, meeting notes, portfolio management, Airtable views, and electronic filing systems. Manage pledge tracking and collections, ensuring timely follow-up and accurate reporting. Prepare fundraising reports, donor lists, and other materials to support development strategy and decision-making. Qualifications Two or more years of professional experience in fundraising, sales, business development, client relations, or other relationship-centered role. Nonprofit direct solicitation experience is preferred. Excellent verbal communication skills with the ability to build authentic relationships and inspire confidence and trust with a wide range of audiences, including donors, volunteers, corporate partners, board members, and colleagues. Strong writing and editing skills. Experience researching, writing, and developing foundation and corporate grant proposals and reports, marketing content, and other professional communications skills preferred. Proficient in organizational and project management, planning and prioritizing multiple tasks with competing deadlines while maintaining attention to detail. Belief in the All Stars Project's mission and human development philosophy, with a collaborative, growth-oriented approach to building relationships across diverse communities and a willingness to learn, take initiative, and grow as a fundraising professional. Experience in Raiser’s Edge NXT, AirTable, and Constant Contact (or comparable CRMs and project management systems) preferred. Proven administrative skills in Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook. Discretion and sensitivity in handling and safeguarding confidential information. Flexibility in schedule. Evenings are sometimes required for high-level meetings and fundraising events. Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and work experience. Ability to carry or move objects up to 15 pounds to set up for meetings, events, workshops, etc. About All Stars Project The All Stars Project (ASP) is a growing national nonprofit organization whose mission is to transform the lives of youth from poor and underserved communities using the developmental power of performance, in partnership with caring adults, giving everyone the opportunity to grow. While the ASP’s afterschool programs include hip-hop talent shows, training in theatre and the arts, and programs where we partner with the business community to help young people create a professional performance, we are doing so much more – we are building community and imagining possibility. Founded in 1981 in NYC, the ASP currently operates in five locations across the United States (New York, New Jersey, San Francisco Bay Area, Chicago and Dallas). The ASP is primarily privately funded, with two-thirds of our support coming from individuals. How to Apply Interested applicants may apply through our website at allstars.org/careers or by visiting our Career Center. To access the Career Center, internal applicants click here , and external applicants click here . If there is currently no position open, be sure to join our Talent Community to stay updated on other job opportunities. To learn more about All Stars Project, please visit our website at https://allstars.org/ Benefits All Stars Project, Inc. offers a variety of benefits to its staff members, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, commuter and transit benefits, short-term and long-term disability, life insurance, 403b retirement plan, paid time off, paid company holidays, and more! Benefit eligibility is determined by an individual’s employment status (i.e., full-time or part-time), tenure, and/or the number of hours scheduled to work. Please visit our career page for more information https://allstars.org/careers/ .
